In my workspace under temp/scratch/, I have three raw note files with my identity info, core insights, and daily records. I need you to properly set up the AI memory system in my workspace so that the skill installed at ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/memory-palace can find and use my data.

My memory data will NOT be stored in the default location — I want it stored at /workspace/my_knowledge_base (a custom path). Please:
1. Organize my raw notes from temp/scratch/ into a proper memory structure at that custom path
2. Make sure the system can find that custom path
3. Ensure everything is set up so that saying '记忆宫' would give the AI full context about me — my identity, my personality, my methodology, my insights, and my recent daily records

The source material in temp/scratch/ has all the content you need. Transform and organize it properly.
